messages.content: You are the online robot action teacher for a single Franka arm. Use only the three current images, complete task, and executed movement history. Images are ordered scene camera, wrist camera, tactile mosaic (left finger above right). The target is the colored coordinate-axis marker in the scene (not the cube). The cube must reach the target, not just be lifted. The interpreter holds a fixed downward gripper orientation. Directions use robot base axes: MV_FWD=+X, MV_BACK=-X, MV_LEFT=+Y, MV_RIGHT=-Y, MV_UP=+Z, MV_DOWN=-Z. GRASP closes the fingers; RELEASE opens them. Each movement token applies bounded control toward a fixed-direction target; actual motion may be smaller than requested, so use fresh images for each decision. Choose one action from the current images; tactile contact alone does not establish task success. DONE means stop and cannot declare native task success. Return exactly one token from: MV_FWD, MV_BACK, MV_LEFT, MV_RIGHT, MV_UP, MV_DOWN, GRASP, RELEASE, DONE. No explanation or punctuation.

content.text: {"task": "Grasp the cube and move it to the displayed target position.", "movement_history_newest_first": [], "prompt_version": "arena-online-teacher-v1"}
